notInTauri.body: This is the development page of the GitManagement desktop app and must be used inside the app window. In a regular browser there is no backend, so directories can't be picked and git operations can't run.
notInTauri.hint: Run the command above in the project root; the GitManagement window opens automatically.

top.syncHint: Sync the current branch by its rules

sidebar.empty: No repositories yet. Click Add below to get started.
sidebar.removeBody: Removes "{{name}}" from GitManagement only. No files on disk are deleted.

banner.abortBody: Runs --abort and restores the state before the operation. Resolved conflicts will be lost.
banner.mergeCommitHint: All conflicts are resolved. Enter a commit message below and click Commit to finish the merge.

rollback.trashNote: Deleted files go to the system Trash / Recycle Bin and can be recovered there.

diff.tooLarge: Large file (over 2 MB or 20,000 lines), not rendered by default.

integrate.conflicts: Conflicts occurred. Resolve them and continue.

settings.title: Settings
settings.autoRefresh: Watch files and refresh status automatically
settings.gitInstallMac: Run xcode-select --install, or use Homebrew: brew install git
settings.gitInstallWin: Download Git for Windows from https://git-scm.com/download/win
settings.name: user.name
settings.credSaved: Credential saved to the system keychain
settings.credNote: The system git credential helper and SSH agent are used first. Tokens saved here are only used when the helper provides none, and are kept in the system keychain, never in plain text.
settings.codeFontHint: Leave empty for the default monospace font
settings.diffColorsHint: Backgrounds and inline highlights are derived from the chosen color for both light and dark themes.
settings.editorHintMac: Application name, e.g. Visual Studio Code, IntelliJ IDEA
settings.editorHintWin: Executable path or command, e.g. code.cmd
settings.terminalHintWin: Empty uses Windows Terminal if installed, otherwise cmd
settings.precheckSecrets: Detect possible secrets (AKIA…, private keys, tokens)
settings.precheckNote: Only lines added in this commit are checked. Findings are shown as a warning; you decide whether to continue.

git.authFailed: Authentication failed. Check your SSH key or save a token under Settings › Credentials.
git.nonFastForward: Push rejected: the remote has commits you don't have (non-fast-forward). Pull first.
git.indexLock: The repository is locked by another git process (index.lock). If no other git process is running, delete .git/index.lock and retry.
git.network: Network error, unable to reach the remote
git.localChangesOverwritten: Local changes would be overwritten. Commit, stash, or use smart checkout.
git.conflict: Conflicts occurred. Resolve them and continue.
git.noUpstream: The current branch has no upstream

commit.invalidAuthor: Author must be in the form Name <email>

credential.error: Failed to access the system keychain

clone.destNotEmpty: Target directory exists and is not empty: {{path}}

push.detachedHead: Cannot push in detached HEAD state. Create a branch first.

operation.none: No merge or rebase in progress
operation.unsupported: Not supported for the current operation

sync.detachedHead: Can't sync by rules in detached HEAD state. Create a branch first.
sync.targetNoRemote: Each target needs a remote or a URL
sync.targetNoBranch: Each target needs a remote branch
sync.noPrimary: The rule has no primary target
sync.primaryIsUrl: The primary target is a URL and can't be written as upstream

conflict.binary: Binary files can't be merged in the 3-way view: {{path}}

stash.notFound: Stash not found (it may have been dropped)
stash.noCommit: The repository has no commits yet; cannot stash
stash.tooManyPaths: Too many files selected ({{count}}); stash all changes instead

partial.unsupported: Partial commit is not supported for this file: {{path}}
partial.stale: {{path}} changed after you selected parts of it; review the selection in the diff again

changelist.lastOne: At least one changelist must remain

open.noEditor: Configure an editor in Settings › External tools first

mapping.pushUrlHint: Leave empty to use the fetch URL. With several push URLs, a push goes to all of them.
mapping.redactedUrl: Credentials in this URL are masked (***). Enter the full URL again or remove the credentials.
mapping.removeRemoteBody: Runs git remote remove {{name}} and deletes its remote-tracking branches.
mapping.removeRemoteUsed: Sync rules reference this remote. Those targets will be flagged and skipped.
mapping.wildcardHint: Wildcards: * stays within a segment, ** crosses /, feature/* matches everything below
mapping.exactHint: Exact match; use * or ? for wildcards
mapping.orderHint: Lower wins; exact names always win over wildcards
mapping.primaryHint: The primary target is written to the git upstream so command-line git pull/push behave the same
mapping.shadowed: These branches are matched by a higher-priority rule, so this rule does not apply to them:
mapping.deleteRuleBody: Deletes rule "{{pattern}}" and all its targets. git config is not changed.

sync.title: Sync by rules
sync.nothing: Nothing to sync. Configure rules for branches under Remotes & Mapping first.
sync.forceBody: These targets will be force-pushed with --force-with-lease. Commits only on the remote will be lost:
sync.conflictStop: Pulling caused conflicts, so the sync stopped. Resolve them and sync again.

conflicts.title: Conflicts ({{op}}: {{theirs}} → {{ours}})
conflicts.binaryHint: Binary files can only be resolved by taking one side
conflicts.deleteHint: One side deleted this file. Accepting that side deletes the file; accepting the other keeps it.

merge.title: Merge {{path}}
merge.unresolvedBody: {{conflicts}} conflict(s) and {{changes}} change(s) are unprocessed. Those blocks keep the base content.
merge.markersBody: The result still contains conflict markers (<<<<<<< / ======= / >>>>>>>).
merge.editedHint: The result was edited manually and will be saved as edited
merge.discardEditsBody: Block actions regenerate the result from block states and overwrite your manual edits.
merge.worktreeEdited: The working-tree file was edited by hand (no conflict markers). The merge is recomputed from base / ours / theirs, and applying overwrites the working-tree file.

log.selectCommit: Select a commit to see details
log.resetBody_soft: Moves {{branch}} to {{hash}}. Changes from later commits stay staged.
log.resetBody_mixed: Moves {{branch}} to {{hash}}. Changes from later commits stay in the working tree (unstaged).

log.revertBody: Create a new commit that reverts {{hash}} "{{subject}}"?
